top_candidates.evidence: Johann Kaspar Füssli (9 March 1743 – 4 May 1786) was a Swiss painter, entomologist, and publisher from Zurich. He was the son of Johann Caspar Füssli (1706–1782), a well-known portrait painter and art historian, and Anna Elisabeth Waser. His family was closely connected to the cultural and intellectual circles of Zurich. Johann Kaspar was the older brother of famous Romantic painter Henry Fuseli, born Johann Heinrich Füssli (1745–1825), whose powerful and imaginative works later gained him international fame. Johann Kaspar married twice: first to Verena Störi in 1770, and then to Anna Elisabeth Kilchsperger in 1774.
